definitions.gloss: superficial; surface-level; outward; on the surface
definitions.explanation: Pertaining only to the surface or appearance, without touching on the deeper substance or reality. Often carries a negative connotation, suggesting something lacks depth.

examples.japanese: {表面的|ひょうめんてき}な{理解|りかい}にとどまる。
examples.english: To remain at a superficial understanding.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{謝罪|しゃざい}は{表面的|ひょうめんてき}なものに{過|す}ぎなかった。
examples.english: His apology was nothing more than superficial.

examples.japanese: {表面的|ひょうめんてき}には{穏|おだ}やかだが、{内面|ないめん}では{葛藤|かっとう}を{抱|かか}えている。
examples.english: On the surface things seem calm, but inside there is inner conflict.

notes: A na-adjective formed from {表面|ひょうめん} (surface) + {的|てき} (adjectival suffix). Used adverbially as {表面的|ひょうめんてき}に (superficially, on the surface). Common collocations: {表面的|ひょうめんてき}な{理解|りかい} (superficial understanding), {表面的|ひょうめんてき}な{付|つ}き{合|あ}い (superficial relationship), {表面的|ひょうめんてき}には (on the surface). Often contrasted with {本質的|ほんしつてき} (essential/fundamental) or {根本的|こんぽんてき} (fundamental).
